observations: Blue alternator head with a triple-belt pulley.
Control box mounted on top with two output terminals.
Technical specification label on top of the control box is unreadable.
The unit is shown standalone on a wooden pallet; no engine is attached.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'ECKO-BIG' are present.

claims.evidence: The technical nameplate in photo 0 is too blurry to read.
Cannot be confirmed without reading the nameplate or seeing the internal wiring.
While terminals are visible, the dual-purpose function is not confirmed by the unreadable label.

risks.proof: Video of the unit producing stable voltage under load while coupled to a motor.
Video of the pulley being spun by hand to check for smooth rotation and lack of noise.
Clear, legible photo of the manufacturer's technical nameplate.

proof_requests: A clear, close-up photo of the technical nameplate on top of the blue box.
A video showing the shaft/pulley being rotated manually.
Confirmation if this is sold as a standalone head or if an engine is included.
response.reason: The capacity (7.5 kVA) and specific functions (welder/generator) cannot be verified because the technical nameplate is unreadable. Since capacity is the primary price driver for alternator heads, a valuation is not possible without this data.
